row_statement: Conjecture 43 of Kuznetsova, Freij-Hollanti and Jurrius (Conjecture 8.4 in arXiv v3: for a representable matroid M and every representation R, the combinatorial derived matroid delta M is above the Oxley-Wang derived matroid delta_OW(R) in the weak order, that is, every dependent set of delta M is dependent in delta_OW(R)) is false: for an explicit rank-4 matrix over F_7 with 8 columns, four circuits form a dependent set of delta M under the source's closure operations while their circuit vectors are linearly independent, for every choice of circuit vectors.

caveats: Not minimal, and there is a simpler underlying fact: Opus found that the Fano matroid over F_2 (7 elements, rank 3) is already a counterexample, found by random search in about a second, and that for both witnesses delta M drops below the rank n-k of every Oxley-Wang derived matroid. Neither is in Lean.
The same rank collapse appears to refute two sibling conjectures of the same paper (MathDB 355015 and 355017). They rest on one fact and are NOT counted separately.

The source tested named families only (small uniform matroids, Q6, M(K4), Vamos). Nothing public was found; two 2023 master's theses, Raz arXiv:2307.05005 and Shin arXiv:2610.30283 were read and do not have a representable counterexample.
